violations.why: closer2_isr (prio 2) reads var1 twice in JudgeCondi; writer1_isr (prio 3) can preempt in between and write it, so the two reads may differ.
writer2_isr (prio 4) can preempt closer2_isr between the two reads of var2 and change the value.
closer3_isr's var3++ is a non-atomic read-modify-write. writer3_isr (prio 5) can preempt it and write 0x33, and the increment then overwrites that write.
